note: Owned by the City of Cedar Falls, operated by Black Hawk County Conservation, in the NE corner of 86-acre Big Woods Lake. Pads sit in an open grid behind a treed strip and the Big Woods Trail, about 70 m from the shore at the nearest. Non-modern area and 3 cabins too. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $35, 50 amp, water, sewer, wifi, FCFS mix; added 55 sites, season closes Dec 1, 2/4-night minimums, showers. Dump not on today's pages, left. Not waterfront stands, with a lakeview lead.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (possible lakeview, not proposed as upgrade): county: 'The campground and cabins overlook Big Woods Lake'. That contrary claim triggers the gate. Measured off campground map and 0.33 m/px imagery: lake is 86 acres; nearest row (sites 7-18) is about 70 m from the shore, across a treed strip and the Big Woods Trail; so no on-water claim (trail plus cabins and dock between). The old note's 'continuous shoreline treeline' is wrong: the belt has a gap around the dock, in front of sites about 14-18, where it's open grass with scattered trees. A view from those sites looks likely, but site pages carry no campsite photos (only maps), and no official image shows it, so unconfirmed: I left not waterfront. If AWH or a site photo confirms, lakeview on about 5 sites. Those sites are first come, first served.

Stored fees note said 'a few sites seven nights' minimum; not on the pages read today (site 2's page says 2/4). Not carried forward; a site-specific 7-night could still exist. Pin fine: about 35 m from the centre of the loops. Website order fine. Dump: stored true (derived from the old note) left alone; today's pages don't mention it.
